assets.description: THE COMPOSITING ASSET: the dancing rave yeti with a real alpha channel and no background at all. Keyed per frame by tools/key-alpha.py: luma ramp 40 to 70 (40 clears the plate and the faint floor, which topped out at 39), then interior holes closed by flood filling the background inward from the frame border and forcing every dark region the flood never reaches to opaque, then unpremultiply to straight alpha.
